qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: Strengthened ToolDescriptionSection guard in ToolFullView.tsx (lines 20-39). New guard: const desc = tool.description?.trim() ?? ''; if (!desc) return null; const rawCommand = tool.input?.command?.trim() ?? ''; if (rawCommand && desc === rawCommand) return null;. For Codex exec_command where tool.description equals tool.input.command (the raw /bin/bash -lc string), the Description section is now hidden. For Claude Code tools where description ≠ command, the section renders as before. Guard confirmed via grep in ToolFullView.tsx:24,28.
